title: Motion and mass report discrimination
question: Which motion/mass dirty and rearm models explain controlled wire reports and bound first input reflection?
hypotheses: A common changed-tuple 42/105 ms gate predicts wire releases.
Elapsed/per-field clocks or direction/event exceptions explain clean short gaps and order differences.
Reflection bounds do not identify true server input-application ticks.
method:
SOURCE REVISION 7580d53baffa35d776af4fc22a9926220d33c672. ENDPOINT UNBOUND: [unbound placeholder removed] is a documentation placeholder, never an official target. Bind using bind_plan.py before init or collection. This plan embeds its complete scientific protocol and common rules.

COMMON RULES

1. Official-listed protocol-19 servers only, at most **two live/connecting/closing official connections globally**, counting any other capture job. Run one invocation at a time. No custom/community/Battledome endpoint, server discovery, unlisted substitute or extra probe. Keep endpoint/list/host/operator details and raw packets in private scratch. A published summary, if separately requested, uses anonymous server strata and source digests.
2. One invocation is the sampling batch. Both members, every life and reconnect stay together. Same-server successive runs are temporal replicates, not independent servers; no packet-level population confidence intervals or permutations. Use one declared endpoint throughout each protocol. Before initialization bind all plans for that protocol to that same endpoint. If it becomes unavailable, stop; changing endpoint requires a new frozen amendment, not substitution.
3. Use the pinned standard collectors through `collect.py`. Do not rewrite them during acquisition. They already record raw i/o, setup, time origin, batch/member identity, commands, ping sends/replies, lifecycle, collector timing, source/plan pins and terminal integrity. The base collector can rejoin after death and retry some connection failures within the same duration; retain that behavior and every event. No replacement invocation, extension, extra life budget outside the duration or retry of a failed invocation. Do not exclude an archive just because a historical cumulative `failures` counter is nonzero: classify actual lifecycle events, retaining requested post-death close intent as in the corrected remote study.
4. `collect.py` durably reserves the invocation and records its child status before audit. Retain incomplete gzip, interrupted receipts, unsupported protocol/challenge, capture errors, empty/missing cohorts and every quarantine. Stop dependent collection on structural/protocol/source/membership/terminal failure or unexpected connection failure after the current child drains. An intact gzip/process exit zero is not scientific route success. If an attempt never started, record it as not attempted, not as empty data. Never remove a lock without checking ownership and process state.
5. Split before raw opening. Freeze ordinal uses the durable `started` order for that plan, not file-name sorting or successful-attempt order. Failed attempts consume their planned ordinal. Never promote later successful attempts into missing cells. Pilot data are acquisition diagnostics, never fitting or validation data. Never fit on held-out bodies, frames, lives, first-half slots or summaries. Save development candidate predictions, parameters, code hashes and selected output hash before opening held-out data. If no executable analyzer is ready, raw acquisition can still be archived, but analysis stays pending; do not inspect held-out summaries while writing that analyzer.
6. Reset every clock/identity at setup, connection and incarnation change. Consume raw packet order and only causal prefixes for earlier state. Separate server elapsed-header clock from monotonic receipt/send clock, and sequence headers from elapsed headers. Never subtract independent setup-relative clocks across recipients. Same-process paired streams use their common recorded `performance.timeOrigin`; retain separate position/body/motion ages. Future survival checks may censor an exposure, but never supply earlier geometry; label that retrospective survival selection.
7. For paired geometry sample an immutable 200 ms grid from invocation start, not an event-selected grid. Require both own anchors age ≤150 ms, a valid positively referenced target identity and uninterrupted life. Never infer absence from a peer whose own stream is dead, disconnected, stale or missing. Query uncertainty buffer is `U = 2 + 437.5*(ownAnchorAge + referenceAnchorAge + batchRTTp95)/1000` world units. This is an engineering sensitivity allowance, **not** an identified upper bound on serialization age. Exclude classification queries within U of a candidate boundary; retain them as interval-ambiguous. Report sensitivity at U/2 and 2U without selecting a preferred result. Preserve body-reconstruction limitations.
8. For geometry require no avoidance/interruption, cross-track error ≤180 units, achieved endpoints within the collector's declared tolerance, and complete causal reference throughout each leg. Initial approaches, unfinished holds, paused legs, deaths, cache/anchor reacquisition and capture-end trials do not count as uninterrupted legs. Endpoint counters do not establish these screens. Collector control permits some staleness pauses up to 500 ms/1,000 ms; that does not relax the 150 ms scientific query gate.
9. Standard collectors' 25 ms control telemetry only flags >75 ms gaps; it **cannot certify clean 5–40 ms receipt timing**. For receipt diagnostics mask intervals when cumulative lateTicks rises plus 100 ms either side, new write backpressure, documented receive errors and missing telemetry; retain full results too. This is only a coarse mask. Never label it the high-resolution remote-study clean mask. P2's primary claims use server-header intervals and raw frame order. No clean home/near-server latency profile, one-way delay or exact input-application tick may be fitted from these standard captures. A fine-timing extension needs separately frozen instrumentation and no-network tests first.
10. Report planned/started/complete/quarantined batches, lives, joined seconds, eligible seconds, legs, query opportunities, exclusions, present/absent and transition denominators by split and stratum. Distinguish undefined from zero. Save each counterexample with archive SHA-256, JSONL line, connection/life/entity, server and receipt clocks and packet bytes. Selection: all eligible observations for summaries; illustrative witness ties choose earliest planned batch then frame. Do not trim extreme values by magnitude.
11. Use nearest-rank quantiles. Give one summary per batch, then equal-weight batch summaries; show every batch. Two held-out batches per condition only support bounded replication, not a population error rate. Selection uses development only; require improvement in **both** held-out batches for the condition, no uncovered required stratum, no new high-confidence contradiction, and the protocol-specific gates below. Report all candidates' errors/missing exposure; inconclusive coverage is a valid result. A successful model discrimination still needs a separately reviewed fixture and appropriate confirmation before simulator adoption.


P2 PROTOCOL
motion/mass reports and input reflection

**Plan:** `02-scheduler-movement.json`, six 600 s invocations, one client; ordinals 1–3 development, 4–6 held out. Ceiling **60 min / 60 connection-minutes**, peak one. Use temporally separated invocations (≥30 min start-to-start), same endpoint; spacing consumes no connections and is not proof of independence.

**Vantage:** quiet machine and near-server recommended for any receipt/input-reflection interpretation. Ordinary home is sufficient for primary server-header gap and same-frame order comparisons, subject to actual command history. Standard telemetry cannot establish fine clean receipt tails.

**Controls:** unchanged movement sequence at size tiers ≥6/15/35: straight cruise 1.2 s, left/right 2.2 s each, reversal holds 1.8 s each, straight boost .85 s, left/right boost 1.1 s each, forage recovery 7 s. Movement executes once per tier per life; deaths restart acquisition. These are realized only when interruption/boost-eligibility logs permit; no imaginary randomized 10–80 ms schedule or custom ping rhythm is claimed.

**Hypotheses:** common changed-tuple gate versus field/direction dirty state; release phase fixed to a server-clock lattice versus time since last reported state; mass event exceptions versus a strict ~100 ms throttle. All are observable reporting models. Exactly six hidden physics ticks cannot be proved/refuted from variable header timestamps.

**Frozen diagnostics:** own/other gaps by family and field mask, same-frame mass/motion/body order, unchanged decoded tuple reports, command holds/reflections, quantized phase residuals, mass-bearing h/r/n/N/+ versus actual credited pickups. Reset on incarnation. Mandatory counters: motion <35 ms, h <100 ms, reverse same-frame mass/motion, entry-to-first versus repeat prey gaps separately. Do not just rediscover their existence; compare their preceding command, field/direction, growth/tail/death and elapsed-silence conditions.

**Candidates:** (a) tuple-change plus report-relative 42 ms motion/105 ms h; (b) tuple-change plus report-relative 40/100 ms; (c) same elapsed thresholds independently per heading/wanted/speed; (d) fixed absolute 42/105 ms opportunities, each phase 0..41/0..104 ms fitted only on development; (e) direction-change or credited-growth/tail event bypass added to (b). Output wire-schedule predictions, not hidden physical event claims. No candidate can use a future value to explain a prior packet. Compare all unchanged-report witnesses against state and direction representation before calling them exceptions.

**Sample rules:** require ≥2 eligible development and ≥2 eligible held-out batches. An eligible batch needs ≥300 joined seconds, ≥20 isolated changed heading commands held ≥150 ms (prior target >2.1 angle-byte units away, no later command before first exact reflected target), ≥4 actual boost transitions and ≥50 credited pickup→next mass-bearing pairs with right-censoring retained. Score motion/mass subquestions separately if one lacks coverage. Superseded/unmatched/unchanged commands stay in the ledger; never count them as failed application by default.

**Analysis:** causal state transitions and send→first exact wanted reflection; lower/upper clock bounds using ping inequalities as in scheduler §10, no RTT/2 subtraction. Clock drift/quantization sensitivity remains separate; insufficient bounds are missing, not midpoint observations. Score candidate packet-state mismatch fraction and median absolute next-report error on server clock by batch, stratified own/other and motion/mass. Prefer lower mismatch, then lower timing error, then baseline/list order on ties. A supported held-out improvement needs ≥20% lower mismatch and ≥2 ms lower timing error in each eligible held-out batch with no worsened event-order contradictions. If states are not identifiable between reports, mark that interval unscored and report denominator; do not manufacture dirty times from receipts. No schedule law is selected from isolated exceptions alone. Failure of all candidates means the next capture needs a new controlled high-rate driver, not an added stochastic exception fit.

sampling.unit: one complete collector invocation, including both members and every life/reconnect
sampling.selection: Use 02-scheduler-movement; durable started ordinal consumes budget even if failed. Follow the embedded P2 split and pilot/coverage gates exactly. No extensions or replacements.
sampling.independence: Packets, entities, legs, lives and simultaneous clients are correlated; batches on one endpoint are temporal replicates, not independent servers. Report batch summaries and missing strata; no population confidence from packet counts.

exclusions: Quarantine structural, source, protocol, member or terminal-integrity failures; preserve originals and durable child outcomes.
Apply embedded causal-prefix, age, uncertainty, route and interference screens. Preserve all excluded rows and denominators.
Do not confuse requested post-death close/error sequences or old cumulative counters with unrequested failures.
Missing required exposure is inconclusive; never retry into a favorable sample or relax a gate.
validation: Apply the embedded P2 held-out ordinals, numerical coverage and improvement criteria. Seal development code/parameters/predictions before any held-out opening. Pilot never contributes to fit/validation. Unsupported strata and all failed attempts remain explicit. This exploratory study alone does not authorize model adoption.
limitations: Client streams are filtered observations, not authoritative world state or a visibility-independent census.
Server elapsed headers do not give a hidden physics tick or inbound/application timestamp; receipts are not one-way latency.
The standard collector's coarse telemetry cannot certify fine clean timing. No new latency fit or absolute uplink split is allowed.
Endpoint and official-list provenance must be bound locally before execution; no live endpoint was queried or collected in preparing this plan.
All per-protocol limitations and missing-coverage outcomes embedded in method apply.
